title: Concept: Dependency locking disabled for all configurations
description: build.gradle declares a build that switches dependency locking off, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a build that switches dependency locking off.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a build that switches dependency locking off.
